description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various locations. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
